interface.description: Curated DCC-MCP plugins, multi-skill bundles, asset providers, and Skills.

skills.name: dcc-mcp-maya-mgear
skills.description: mGear Shifter rigging integration for DCC-MCP — inspect, build, and manage mGear rigs
examplePrompts: Build a mGear Shifter biped rig from the current Maya guide and report every component it created
Inspect which mGear modules and versions are loaded in this Maya session
Import the exported mGear rig back into the scene and verify the control hierarchy

recovery.on: mGear is not importable in the running Maya interpreter
recovery.next: dcc-mcp-cli marketplace inspect dcc-mcp-maya-mgear

recovery.on: guide or component validation fails before the build starts
recovery.next: run the mgear inspection tool to list the offending guide nodes, fix them in Maya, then rebuild

recovery.on: a partially built rig is left in the scene after a failed build
recovery.next: undo back to the pre-build state with a single Maya undo step, delete the leftover rig group, then rebuild

skills.name: dcc-mcp-maya-advancedskeleton
skills.description: AdvancedSkeleton rigging for DCC-MCP — inspect templates, create or import FitSkeletons, and build or rebuild Maya rigs
examplePrompts: List the AdvancedSkeleton templates available in this Maya session
Create a FitSkeleton from the selected biped template and report the joints it placed
Rebuild the existing AdvancedSkeleton rig after I move the FitSkeleton joints

recovery.on: AdvancedSkeleton is not installed or not importable in Maya
recovery.next: dcc-mcp-cli marketplace inspect dcc-mcp-maya-advancedskeleton

recovery.on: no FitSkeleton or template exists in the scene yet
recovery.next: create a FitSkeleton from a template first, then retry the rig build

recovery.on: the rebuild produced a duplicate or broken rig
recovery.next: undo the rebuild with a single Maya undo step, delete the duplicate rig group, then rebuild from the FitSkeleton

skills.name: dcc-mcp-maya-procedural-architecture
skills.description: Generate six seeded Maya house styles with realistic or stylized Arnold materials, cancellable progress, and optional CC0 HDR lighting
examplePrompts: Generate three seeded suburban house variants in Maya with Arnold materials and report the mesh counts
Build one stylized cottage with a CC0 HDRI from ambientCG and frame it with the existing camera
Cancel the running house generation and tell me what was already created

recovery.on: Bifrost or Arnold is unavailable in this Maya version
recovery.next: dcc-mcp-cli marketplace inspect dcc-mcp-maya-procedural-architecture

recovery.on: HDR download fails or ambientCG is unreachable
recovery.next: fall back to the built-in studio HDR preset and re-run the same seed

recovery.on: generation was cancelled part way and left stray geometry
recovery.next: undo with a single Maya undo step, delete the leftover house group, then re-run with a new seed

skills.name: dcc-ui-qt-inspector
skills.description: Read-only Qt inspection for DCC-MCP CUA and UI Control selector discovery
examplePrompts: Inspect the Qt widget tree of the running Houdini session and list every dialog title
Find a stable selector for the render settings Apply button in this DCC
Report which Qt widgets are currently visible under the main window

recovery.on: no Qt binding is available in the target DCC process
recovery.next: dcc-mcp-cli marketplace inspect dcc-ui-qt-inspector

recovery.on: the widget tree is empty or the target window is not found
recovery.next: confirm the DCC window is open and re-run the inspection; it is read-only so nothing needs to be undone

skills.name: dcc-ui-qt-actions
skills.description: Structured Qt actions for DCC-MCP CUA and UI Control workflows backed by dcc-cua
examplePrompts: Click the Apply button in the Houdini render settings dialog and report the resulting widget state
Set the frame range fields in the open Qt dialog and verify the values were accepted
Drive the Nuke write node creation dialog through structured Qt actions

recovery.on: the target selector no longer resolves in the live UI
recovery.next: dcc-mcp-cli marketplace inspect dcc-ui-qt-inspector

recovery.on: the action was applied but the widget state did not change
recovery.next: re-inspect the widget tree to find the updated selector, then retry the single action

recovery.on: an action sequence left the dialog in a partially edited state
recovery.next: restore the dialog to its saved settings from the DCC preferences, then undo the field edits and re-run

skills.name: dcc-ui-workflow-memory
skills.description: Structured workflow memory for DCC-MCP CUA and UI Control automation backed by dcc-cua
examplePrompts: Record the Qt selector path for building a Nuke write node so later runs can reuse it
Recall the stored workflow for publishing a Houdini render and list its verified steps
Store this successful Qt action sequence as a reusable workflow for Substance Painter

recovery.on: no stored workflow matches the requested task
recovery.next: dcc-mcp-cli marketplace inspect dcc-ui-workflow-memory

recovery.on: a stored selector no longer resolves in the live UI
recovery.next: re-inspect the widget tree, then update the stored workflow with the new selector

recovery.on: a workflow was recorded with an incomplete or wrong step
recovery.next: discard the recorded workflow entry and re-record it from the verified action sequence

recovery.on: the download produced a partial or empty model file

skills.description: Search Google Fonts or download a verified keyless font with family and license metadata
examplePrompts: Download the Inter font family with its license and report the installed files
Search Google Fonts for a CJK-capable sans-serif and download it
Download this specific Google Fonts family and verify the file checksum

recovery.on: the Google Fonts API is unreachable or the key is rejected
recovery.next: dcc-mcp-cli marketplace inspect dcc-asset-google-fonts

recovery.on: the requested family or weight does not exist
recovery.next: inspect the family to list available weights and subsets, then download a published one

recovery.on: font files downloaded without license metadata
recovery.next: delete the download or add the license file before using the font in a shipped build

skills.name: dcc-asset-openstreetmap-city
skills.description: Download bounded OpenStreetMap buildings, roads, railways, water, and land use as attributed GeoJSON
examplePrompts: Download buildings and roads for this bounding box from OpenStreetMap as GeoJSON
Get land use and water polygons for this city block as attributed GeoJSON
Export OpenStreetMap railways for this area and report the feature counts

recovery.on: the Overpass API is unreachable or rate limited
recovery.next: dcc-mcp-cli marketplace inspect dcc-asset-openstreetmap-city

recovery.on: the bounding box returns no features or exceeds the query limit
recovery.next: shrink the bounding box or split it into tiles, then re-run the download

recovery.on: the GeoJSON is truncated or fails to parse
recovery.next: delete the partial file and re-run with a smaller bounding box, then verify it parses

skills.name: dcc-asset-overture-city
skills.description: Download bounded Overture Maps buildings, transportation, infrastructure, land cover, and water as licensed GeoJSON
examplePrompts: Download Overture Maps buildings for this bounding box as licensed GeoJSON
Get Overture transportation and land cover layers for this city tile
Export Overture water and infrastructure features for this area and report the counts

recovery.on: the overturemaps CLI is missing or the release download fails
recovery.next: dcc-mcp-cli marketplace inspect dcc-asset-overture-city

recovery.on: the bounding box is empty or the requested theme has no features
recovery.next: check the bounding box order and list available themes, then re-run the download

recovery.on: the exported GeoJSON is partial or unparseable
recovery.next: delete the partial export and re-run with a smaller bounding box, then verify it parses

skills.name: dcc-plugin-github-releases
skills.description: Inspect licensed open-source GitHub projects and download release plugin packages with SHA-256 metadata
examplePrompts: Find the latest release of a licensed open-source After Effects plugin and report its download URL and SHA-256
Check whether this GitHub project's license allows studio redistribution before I download it
Download the pinned plugin release asset and verify its SHA-256 matches the manifest

recovery.on: the rate limit blocks GitHub API access
recovery.next: dcc-mcp-cli marketplace inspect dcc-plugin-github-releases

recovery.on: the project license is missing or not redistributable
recovery.next: stop and report the license finding to the user instead of downloading the asset

recovery.on: SHA-256 verification fails after download
recovery.next: delete the unverified download, re-download the pinned asset, and re-verify the SHA-256

skills.name: dcc-mcp-cache-inspector
skills.description: Host-neutral, bounded read-only inspection for SideFX .geo, .bgeo, and .bgeo.sc geometry caches
examplePrompts: Inspect this Houdini .bgeo.sc cache and report the primitive and point counts per frame
List the attributes stored in this geometry cache without loading the whole sequence
Compare the attribute layout of two .geo frames and report what changed

recovery.on: the blosc dependency is missing or the cache uses an unsupported codec
recovery.next: dcc-mcp-cli marketplace inspect dcc-mcp-cache-inspector

recovery.on: the cache file is truncated or reports zero primitives
recovery.next: re-export the cache from Houdini, then re-run the read-only inspection

recovery.on: inspection exceeds the bounded read limit
recovery.next: re-run with a narrower attribute or frame range; inspection is read-only so nothing needs to be undone
